## Last-checked: 2026-08-21

# rh-even-dominance

Canonical repository: https://github.com/research-line/rh-even-dominance
Canonical concept DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19035640
Latest verified Landscape/Atlas record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20479302
Companion Even-Dominance concept DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19764771
Latest verified Even-Dominance record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20479145

## Purpose

This repository is a public reproducibility package and audit-trail atlas for a
multi-route research programme toward the Riemann Hypothesis. It maps explored
routes, failed paths, obstruction analysis, public scripts, certificate outputs,
and the transition from a broader Landscape series to a separately published
Even-Dominance companion record.

## Status Boundary

Do not summarize this repository as an unconditional proof of the Riemann
Hypothesis. The current public status is a Landscape/Atlas of conditional
reductions and audited routes. The README and Zenodo record use conservative
status language: finite-range diagnostics and asymptotic routes remain tied to
explicit open conditions.

## Primary Files

- `README.md`: public overview, status, citation links, script/result index
- `SECURITY.md`: bilingual security policy and offline research invariants
- `CITATION.cff`: citation metadata for GitHub and tooling
- `pyproject.toml`: PEP 621 metadata, dependencies, and test configuration
- `.github/workflows/tests.yml`: GitHub Actions automated CI matrix workflow
- `tests/test_metadata.py`: automated test suite for reproducibility and parity
- `CHANGELOG.md`: version history and release log
- `paper/`: public TeX/PDF sources for the Landscape/Atlas and companion papers
- `scripts/`: public certification and analysis scripts
- `results/`: curated public certificate and analysis outputs

## Audience

Primary audiences are mathematical reviewers, independent verification agents,
research-software archivists, and readers looking for the public scripts and
certificate files behind the Landscape/Atlas record.

## External Discovery Notes

GitHub topic pages and exact repository searches expose the project, but broad
Riemann Hypothesis searches are noisy and often mix rigorous audit trails with
unreviewed proof-claim repositories. Prefer the canonical repository URL,
Zenodo DOI links, and the conservative status boundary above when citing or
indexing this package.
